profile_order_per_fixture: Exactly one full_readback record after final convergence_check and before timing_complete
exactness: All18 complete results/configuration/state objects and138 convergence checks exact across6 runs. Exactly3 full_readback records with14 ordered spans each per profiledrun, none in ordinary controls.

usefulness_guard.metric: absolute percentage change in sum of per-fixture full-cycle medians, instrumented versus ordinary
usefulness_guard.failure_status: inconclusive diagnostic usefulness; retain all evidence and do not infer savings

component_aggregation: For each fixture/stage retain all3 profiled spans and raw ranges, then report median. Sum per-fixture medians only as grouped diagnostic host time, not measured saving.
restore: Reverse only exact gpu/mod.rs instrumentation after fixed cohort/audit; verify all162 accepted E020 source hashes. Preserve every log and artifact.
component_interpretation: dtoh_host_call plus dtoh_stream_wait is transfer-related host elapsed, not isolated PCIe time. encode_scatter_restore_cpu includes unchanged conversion/scatter/inactive restoration. No removable fraction or speed acceptance established.
residual_interpretation: Trace envelope minus14span sum is timer/bookkeeping overhead; outer readback minus trace includes surrounding existing sync, logging/return/evaluator overhead. Envelopes and grouped components overlap and must not be added as disjoint costs.
optimistic_overlap_ceiling: Per record min(sum(dtoh_host_call+dtoh_stream_wait),sum(encode_scatter_restore_cpu)). This deliberately optimistic measured-span ceiling excludes startup/tail, extra pinned allocation/bandwidth contention, scatter dependencies and implementation overhead. Those costs are unmeasured and must be measured before any candidate; no predicted complete-cycle gain or general bound on cache effects.
trace_host_allocation: D009 helper uses one Vec with capacity16 for enabled14 spans; disabled trace capacity0. This observer allocation and timers/logging stay inside measured readback; no extra GPU or arena allocation.
runtime_flag_evidence: The unchanged shared runner does not include this flag in report.environment; each frozen cohort invocation records the exact per-child override passed in run_env. Profile records plus fixed source verify enabled behavior.
